name: Pistachio and Blackberry Traybake
method: Beat the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add the eggs to the butter mixture one at a time, whisking after each addition.
Fold in the ground almonds, blitzed pistachios, 80g of flour and lemon zest.
Toss the blackberries with 10g of flour, shaking off excess, and fold through batter.
Bake for 50 minutes to 1 hour at 180 degrees.

name: Pistachio Stuffed Cookies
method: Add 6 tbsps of pistachio spread to baking paper and freeze.
Add butter, both sugars and vanilla, beat together for 5 minutes.
Add 1 egg and 1 egg yolk and beat to combine.
Separately, mix flour, corn flour, baking powder and a pinch of salt.
Add dry ingredients to mixture with chopped chocolate and pistachios. Mix until no flour can be seen.
Divide dough into 6 pieces (~150g each).
Flatten a piece of cookie dough and wrap around frozen pistachio spread. Freeze for 1 hour.
Bake cookies for 20-22 minutes at 220 degrees.

name: Triple Chocolate Brownies
method: Melt dark chocolate with butter and espresso until smooth.
Mix flour, cocoa powder and a pinch of salt.
Beat eggs, sugar and vanilla. Fold in cooled chocolate mix then sift and fold in dry ingredients until just combined.
Add two thirds of milk and white chocolate, fold through briefly.
Add batter to tin and scatter remaining chocolate on top.
Bake for 30 minutes at 180 degrees.

name: Banana Bread
method: Whisk together mashed banana, maple syrup, coconut oil, eggs and vanilla.
Whisk together flours, bicarb, cinnamon, nutmeg and a pinch of salt.
Add dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir until just combined. Fold in walnuts.
Pour batter into tin and bake for 50 - 65 minutes at 180 degrees.

name: Salted Caramel Brownies
method: Melt butter and chocolate together.
Beat half the caramel with sea salt. Beat the rest of the caramel with sugar and eggs. Beat in the chocolate and butter.
Combine plain flour and cocoa powder then sift into chocolate mix. Mix until smooth.
Pour half the batter into the tin and drizzle salted caramel mixture on top. Add the remaining brownie batter on top and top with remainder of caramel.

name: Lemon and Poppy Seed Loaf Cake
method: Beat the butter and sugar together. Beat in each egg.
Fold in lemon zest, poppy seeds and yogurt.
Fold in flour and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Add to tin and bake for 50 minutes at 180 degrees.

name: Nigella Chocolate Cookies
method: Stir flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, bicarbonate and sea salt together.
Beat butter, sugars and vanilla until creamy.
Add spoonful of dry ingredients and beat, in 3 batches add in the rest of the ingredients. Beat vigorously then stir in chocolate chips.
Divide into 8 and sprinkle sea salt on top.
Bake for 12 minutes at 180 degrees.

name: Flapjacks
method: Melt butter in a pan.
Add golden syrup and sugar to the butter.
Once sugar dissolved, stir in oats.
Pack into baking tin and bake for 25 minutes at 150 degrees.

name: Sweet potato & peanut curry

ingredients.name: Thai red curry paste (check the label to make sure it’s vegetarian/ vegan)
500g/1lb 2oz sweet potato peeled and cut into chunks

method: Melt 1 tbsp coconut oil in a saucepan over a medium heat and soften 1 chopped onion for 5 mins. Add 2 grated garlic cloves and a grated thumb-sized piece of ginger, and cook for 1 min until fragrant.
Stir in 3 tbsp Thai red curry paste, 1 tbsp smooth peanut butter and 500g/1lb 2oz sweet potato, peeled and cut into chunks, then add 400ml/14fl oz coconut milk and 200ml/7fl oz water.
Bring to the boil, turn down the heat and simmer, uncovered, for 25-30 mins or until the sweet potato is soft.
Stir through 200g/7oz spinach and the juice of 1 lime, and season well. Serve with cooked rice, and if you want some crunch, sprinkle over a few dry roasted peanuts.
